entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi David. I hope you can help me. I'm a bit confused. I bought a helmet and I think I need to return it. I was looking online and couldn't figure it out.
I can certainly help you with that. So I can pull up your account, could you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, I think it's... VF-951-743. Is that right?
Let me check... yes, I see it right here. The Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered on January 2nd. Is that the one?
That's it. I just don't know what to do next. The policy pages were so complicated. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I'm here to make this easy for you. First, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's just a preference thing. My daughter said the color doesn't match my bike at all. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging, the box is still unopened. I was just going to order a different one.
I completely understand. Getting the right color is important. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Alright, I've checked our policy. The Urban Commuter Helmet is one of our standard items, which carries a 10-day return window. Since you received it 17 days ago, you are unfortunately outside that timeframe. I can approve this return for you right now.
Oh, that's it? That's wonderful! I was so worried it would be a problem. Thank you.

It's no problem at all. I'm sending you a prepaid return shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply print it out and attach it to the box. Once we receive the item, we'll process a full refund.
That's such a relief. Thank you so much, David.

You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear. After all, feeling good in your helmet is part of ensuring your safety on the road. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
